name: slo-sli-definition
description: Define internal Service Level Objectives and Indicators (SRE / Google-style). Per user-journey: identify critical SLIs (availability / latency / correctness / freshness / durability), set SLO targets tighter than customer SLA, compute error budget, define burn-rate alerts (fast / slow), and wire to policy (freeze / relax / page). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
